title: Stable stores
body: A food tin is tied to a stable key with a route note warning the next driver not to take the tree road. The return time is crossed out.
rival_reading: A field crew could have used the stable and avoided an unsafe road; the crossed-out time does not say why.
gloss: A supply cache is tied to a key and a route whose return time was removed.

cites.quote: guns and food in far stable
